detailed_descriptions.en: The world as you know it is over. The dreaded zombie apocalypse has arrived. You are ready to make your last stand and go down in a blaze of glory… PROBLEM IS, you’re too good at this asymmetric warfare thing, and this “last stand” is taking forever. At this point, this is not about survival — this is about FUN . Shoot them, burn them, blow them up, and, if all else fails, SHRED THE DEAD — with your very own heavy-duty industrial shredder, of course. ZOMBIE BLENDER Get into a flow state of methodically decimating the unending deluge of zombies — or have your grunts do it for you! Or both! BRANCHING OUT As you turn more and more zombies into mincemeat, explore the vast skill tree to optimize the killing! LOCK AND LOAD Kit your grunts out with the best toys you can get your hands on — after all, zombies are nice enough to deliver the loot right to your doorstep! EMBRACE THE YUCK Zombies are known to evolve, but evolution is boring and takes too long. Why not have your mad scientist speed it up a little? With predictably gross results, of course!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The world as you know it is over.

The dreaded zombie apocalypse has arrived.

You are ready to make your last stand and go down in a blaze of glory…

 

PROBLEM IS, you’re too good at this asymmetric warfare thing, and this “last stand” is taking forever. At this point, this is not about survival — this is about FUN. Shoot them, burn them, blow them up, and, if all else fails, SHRED THE DEAD — with your very own heavy-duty industrial shredder, of course.

ZOMBIE BLENDER

Get into a flow state of methodically decimating the unending deluge of zombies — or have your grunts do it for you! Or both!

BRANCHING OUT

As you turn more and more zombies into mincemeat, explore the vast skill tree to optimize the killing!

LOCK AND LOAD

Kit your grunts out with the best toys you can get your hands on — after all, zombies are nice enough to deliver the loot right to your doorstep!

EMBRACE THE YUCK

Zombies are known to evolve, but evolution is boring and takes too long. Why not have your mad scientist speed it up a little? With predictably gross results, of course!
